question: As on June 2023, who launched the multi-lingual India Legal App, legal helpline accessible to the citizens to obtain legal assistance from their homes?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Justice M. N. Venkatachaliah.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• M.N. Venkatachaliah launched the India Legal App on June 13, 2023

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__

__
 
• The **app is a multilingual **helpline that provides legal assistance to citizens from their homes. 
 
• The **app is designed to benefit a wide range of people,** including: Lawyers, Students, and Underprivileged people who don't have access to justice.
 
• The aim of this app is to ensure that nobody is left behind in getting access to justice due to a lack of resources or other reasons.
 
• The app can be used in 6 Indian languages, including English, Hindi, Gujarati, Marathi, Bengali and Punjabi.
 
• Slowly, **this facility will extend to even those without mobile phones.**
 
• They can avail of this service through their nearest common service centres, or Jan Suvidha Kendra/Setu/e-Seva Kendra/Pragya Kendra.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• M.N. Venkatachaliah was appointed Permanent Judge of the High Court of Karnataka w.e.f. 6.11.1975.

 
 
• He was appointed Judge of the Supreme Court of India w.e.f. 5.10.1987.
 
• He was appointed Chief Justice of India w.e.f. 12.2.1993 and he retired on 24.10.1994.
